body:
"Application Security Verification - The technical assessment of an application against the OWASP MASVS" -> "Application Security Verification - The technical assessment of an application against the OWASP ASVS"

Hardcoded keys - "Cryptographic keys which are stored in the device itself."
- I think this needs to be reworded

SSO - ... "logs in to one Client and is then signed in to other Clients automatically, regardless of the platform"
- I think a better definition is: "logs into one application and is then automatically logged into other applications without having to re-provide their credentials"

comments.body: Agreed, have reworded with your suggestions, thanks
